walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Sociology specification.

Sociological Theories & Approaches appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Sociological Theories & Approaches in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Sociological Theories & Approaches.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
